title: Alfred Wegener
summary: Alfred Wegener, born in Berlin on 1 November 1880, trained in astronomy and worked as a meteorologist and polar researcher. In 1912 he proposed continental drift and later described a single ancient supercontinent. He died in Greenland in 1930 during his final expedition.

as_recorded.value: Born in Berlin 1880; died 1930 on the German Greenland Expedition (1930-1931)

importance.justification: Originator of the continental drift hypothesis, a forerunner of plate tectonics.
